structure: Part 6, Consignment addresses. Read in full: prototype-specs/e2e/consignment-parties.fit.spec.js (its 'consignment addresses' describe, plus the SECTION_COPY and ADD_ADDRESS_PATH tables), the 'consignment addresses' describe of snagging.fit.spec.js (S32, S33, S36, S37), support/journey.js's CORE_ADDRESSES, chooseAddress and fillCph, and all 12 trace zips the part names, each opened and its full action list taken: 8 from consignment-parties (cattle five roles plus the CPH number, 80 actions; cat permanent address replaces the CPH number, 64; picking an address for every role then the CPH number, 213; remove takes an address off a role, 75; same as place of origin / same as consignee shortcuts, 83; save and return to hub from a picker, 55; the address search on a picker filters the list, 61; a picker continued with nothing chosen, 55) and 4 from snagging (S32 page layout empty and complete, 120; S33 place of origin address search bar, 102; S36 address selection pages, 143; S37 CPH number typing moves to the next box, 96). Every trace walks the opening run (create notification, origin France, commodity cattle or cat, reason Internal market / Breeding, consignment details) then navigates straight to /roles-and-addresses; that run belongs to other parts and is not claimed here. Pages in this slice, in order: (1) /roles-and-addresses 'Consignment addresses', always reached, back link to /notification-hub; six sections for cattle (place of origin, consignor, consignee, importer, place of destination, CPH number) or five plus 'Permanent address' for a cat; each section shows an add link when empty, or an inset with the chosen address and Change / Remove when filled, with 'Same as place of origin' / 'Same as consignee' shortcut buttons conditional on those roles being filled. (2) Five per-role pickers, /place-of-origin, /consignor-or-exporter, /consignee, /importer, /place-of-destination: caption 'Addresses', role heading, 'Add a new address' secondary button, intro, client-side search 'Search' / 'Name, address or country', results count, a table of radio rows (Name, Address, Country, View), the place of destination alone carrying a fraud warning; back link to /roles-and-addresses. (3) /cph-number 'Add the county parish holding number (CPH)', cattle only (a cat is redirected back), a 'What is a CPH number?' details and three visually-labelled-hidden boxes that auto-advance with JavaScript. Snapshot pointers: roles empty cattle action 50 and cat action 42; roles complete action 189 (every-role trace) and S32 action 94; pickers actions 44, 58, 72, 86, 100 (every-role trace); CPH action 159; search filtered T7 action 48 and S33 action 52; no-JS S33 action 84 and S37 action 78. Mobile screenshots (S32, S36) were read as images where the trace holds them; DOM snapshots render at 1280px so mobile layout is read from the screenshots and the page's media rules only. The network log shows only server-rendered page loads and static assets (including a roles-and-addresses.js script); no data call to another system was seen.

claims.statement: The CPH boxes' labels County, Parish and Holding number are visually hidden (1px, clipped): on screen the user sees only the legend, the hint and three unlabelled boxes, while screen readers get each label.
claims.ref: trace snagging--consignment-addresses-s37-cph-number-typing-moves-to-the-next-box.zip snapshot and screenshot action 52, computed style of .govuk-date-input__label
claims.quote: County:absolute/1px/1px/rect(0px, 0px, 0px, 0px)/block ; Parish:absolute/1px/1px/rect(0px, 0px, 0px, 0px)/block ; Holding number:absolute/1px/1px/rect(0px, 0px, 0px, 0px)/block
claims.note: Hiding the date input item labels is a departure from the GOV.UK date input pattern.

claims.statement: With JavaScript, typing a full box moves focus to the next box: after '12' in County the focus is in Parish, and typing '12', '345', '6789' in one run fills all three boxes.
claims.ref: trace snagging--consignment-addresses-s37-cph-number-typing-moves-to-the-next-box.zip actions 46-59, screenshot action 52 (Parish focused), snapshot action 59

claims.note: Driven by custom JavaScript (data-module app-cph-number-input); no accepted component gives auto-advance.

claims.statement: Without JavaScript the CPH boxes do not auto-advance: typing '123456789' into County keeps only '12' (its maxlength) and leaves Parish and Holding number empty.

The traces show no error state for the CPH page: no error message for a partial, non-numeric or wrong-length CPH number, and no message that the CPH number is needed.

claims.statement: The traces show no error state for the consignment addresses page or the pickers: nothing shows what happens when the user continues from the consignment addresses page with roles still empty, or whether any role is mandatory.

No trace shows the consignment addresses page for pigs, for other species, or for a germinal products notification, so which sections those show (CPH number, permanent address, neither) is not shown.

No trace removes the CPH number or presses the roles page's 'Save and return to overview' or 'Cancel and return to overview'; the CPH page's 'Save and return to hub' is not pressed either.

The pages in this slice are server-rendered by the prototype with no call to another system: the network log holds only page loads, form posts and static assets, so the address lists come from the prototype's own data, not an address book or reference-data service.
